hypotheses.title: Technology Economics
hypotheses.statement: Stellarator operating advantages may compensate for higher engineering complexity and capital costs.
hypotheses.assessment: Conditional plant-economic mechanisms explored; comparative engineering and cost advantage not established.
hypotheses.next_evidence: Comparable plant boundaries, calibrated costs and credible net-generation/maintenance evidence.

hypotheses.title: Commercialization Strategy
hypotheses.statement: Industrial and utility partnerships may mitigate financing and commercialization risks.
hypotheses.assessment: Declared roles and commitments described; causal risk reduction and company-level retained value not quantified.
hypotheses.next_evidence: Contractual funding, liabilities, ownership, control and retained cash flows under comparable strategy cases.

hypotheses.title: Manufacturing Scalability
hypotheses.statement: Standardization and accumulated manufacturing experience may reduce reactor construction costs.
hypotheses.assessment: Component-learning scenarios calculated; observed fusion learning rates and industrial investment requirements remain unknown.
hypotheses.next_evidence: Measured component cost shares, repeat-production evidence, cost floors and deployment/industrial investment requirements.
